title: KX250 Motocross (Urban Commuter)
description: Positioned for riders seeking dedicated Middleweight Sportbike capability, the Kawasaki KX250 Motocross (Urban Commuter) delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. A 250cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. Focused on closed-course control and sporting precision, its Aggressive Forward Tuck posture pairs with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort to optimize high-speed aerodynamic stability.
